To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the STFs that are highly effective in ballistic applications are those that shear thickened discontinuously, had a high packing fraction, and were made from smaller particles and a lower molecular weight dispersion phase.

the best material configuration for shear thickening fluid (STF) for ballistic body armor application is a high concentration STF with a low viscosity continuous medium, a small particle size, and a low molecular weight polyethylene glycol.
STFs with high solid loading, high shear thickening, and small particle size, are highly effective for ballistic body armor.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new type of ballistic armor that utilizes a novel class of materials, namely, shear thickening fluids, and the development of the fundamental understanding of the underlying physics of these materials and their ballistic performance.
the development and characterization of novel STF materials and the use of such STFs to improve the ballistic performance of high-strength fabric armor.
the development of a novel STF material system for ballistic protection applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
STF-Armors are a viable and promising alternative to ceramic armors.

the STFs that exhibit discontinuous shear thickening are highly effective in ballistic applications and that STF-Armors with high shear thickening properties are highly effective in reducing the ballistic penetration of the high-velocity projectiles.
the best STF for ballistic applications is the one that thickens discontinuously and has the smallest particle size dispersed phase.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the STF-Armors are highly effective in enhancing ballistic performance of fabrics and that the rheological properties and the material configuration of the STF are the key factors governing the performance of STF treated fabrics.
the STF-Armors are highly effective against small caliber projectiles and the STF-Arms are effective against high caliber projectiles.
the design of a STF material configuration based on the rheological characterization is an efficient way of optimizing the performance of a STF treated high strength fabric for ballistic body armor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
STFs with high shear thickening response and low viscosity in the low shear rate range are the best suited for body armor applications.
the rheological characterization of STF materials is essential to obtain the best performing STF for ballistic body armor application.
a simple, inexpensive, and easy-to-prepare STF can be developed to achieve the best ballistic performance.
